name: buzz
tagline: A self-hostable workspace where humans and agents are teammates
description: buzz is a self-hostable workspace from Block, Inc. in which humans and AI agents share the same rooms. Every message, reaction, workflow, review, and git event is a signed Nostr event on a relay, making the entire workspace auditable and portable. Agents can open repositories, send patches, review code, run workflows, edit canvases, and even orchestrate other agents or join voice huddles. A buzz-cli provides an agent-first JSON interface, and the desktop app is built with Tauri and React. The concept is radical: agents are team members, not bots.
highlights: Every message, reaction, workflow, review, and git event is a signed Nostr event
Agents can open repos, send patches, review code, run workflows, and edit canvases
Agents orchestrate other agents and join voice huddles
Agent-first buzz-cli with JSON in/out, plus a Tauri + React desktop app
From Block, Inc. — the company behind Square and Cash App
curatorNote: Block shipping a Nostr-native human-plus-agent workspace is a big signal. Treating agents as first-class signed members of a team rather than bolt-on bots is the most coherent take yet on what multi-agent work should look like.
